purpose: Measure pull-request workflow fan-out from exact workflow source, preserve intentionally global safety checks, block silent fan-out growth, and provide a deterministic basis for bounded no-safety-loss reductions.
reductionLaw: Never remove a domain check merely to reduce run count.
Common action-pin compatibility may be proven centrally before domain workflow self-triggers are removed.
Real domain source changes must continue to wake the relevant verifier.
Privileged writers/controllers must not gain PR authority as part of fan-out reduction.
Protected global workflow-change checks fail closed if silently removed.
Every reduction batch requires exact-head checks and post-merge production proof.
